newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P lowers Yamaichi counterparty rating to BBB.
newsitem.headline: S&P lowers Yamaichi counterparty rating to BBB.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday it had lowered Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd's long-term counterparty rating to BBB from BBB+.
The credit rating agency also said Yamaichi's rating outlook has been changed to stable from negative.
The downgrade reflects Yamaichi's prolonged poor performance and an expected negative impact from ongoing deregulation in the Japanese securities industry, Standard & Poor's said.
Nevertheless, Standard & Poor's said that Yamaichi's rating outlook is stable because restructuring efforts at the brokerage are already in progress.
